name: factor
wording: One independent lever of an agent, which no other factor's value determines, so two agents differ only where a factor's value differs. The factors fall in six groups: identity, authority, reach, cognition (model, memory), interface (assignment, deliverable) and governance (guardrails, evaluation). How firmly a value holds is no factor but an attribute every value carries; deployment choices, such as the harness or how a session starts, are no factors.
reason: The operator: the design state a session reads was long human prose restating facts across concepts and carrying decisions with their situations; its reader is a model, so the state is the design alone, each concept as its established name and residue, and decisions and their reasons are history. Restated as its established name and residue, standalone, each fact in the one concept it belongs to, with the meaning standing decisions carried folded in.
